title: Yellowed Charred Ethiopian Lamb Fir Fir
description: A charred, tender, solo-dinner Ethiopian dish featuring gherkin relish, fold, low-calorie-friendly, in the form of fir-fir.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, berbere spice, salt, and black pepper.
Add the lamb pieces to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Spread the lamb pieces on a baking sheet and roast in the oven for 20 minutes.
While the lamb is cooking, heat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped onion to the skillet and cook until it is lightly charred.
Add the minced garlic to the skillet and cook for 1 minute.
Add the gherkin relish to the skillet and stir to combine with the onion and garlic.
Once the lamb is done, add it to the skillet and stir to combine with the relish mixture.
Add the torn injera bread to the skillet and stir to combine with the lamb and relish mixture.
Cook for an additional 2 minutes, stirring constantly, until the bread is lightly toasted.
